lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: You've been on my campus eleven minutes and you have not looked at one single thing you'd look at if you worked here. Not the benches, not the units on the lawn, not the whiteboard. You looked at the end room and then you looked at the exits.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: Callum Strand. I'm twenty-nine, this is mine, and people find that either impressive or obscene depending entirely on what they wanted out of the afternoon before they arrived.

lines.speaker: player
lines.text: You sign a charter this Thursday. Nine pages, five signatures, and a clause on page six about perpetuity.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: I sign a charter this Thursday. Four people in the world know that. I can name all four, and none of them is you.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: So either you're a fifth person I don't know about, which is a problem I can solve by lunchtime, or you're something considerably more interesting, which is not a problem at all.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: Here's what I think, and I'm aware how it sounds. I think you've been somewhere I haven't. I think you're going to tell me it went badly. And I think you want to stop me, which means you think I'm the one doing it, and that is the first genuinely new idea anyone has had about me in two years.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: I'm still waiting to be told what it is I do that's so unforgivable. Nobody will say it plainly. Wren won't, Dax looks at the wall, and you change the subject beautifully.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: That's how I know it's large. Small things people tell you straight away.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: A seat with my name on it. Occupied. Three centuries out. I have read my own register entry in my own hand, and the signature has not changed once in all that time, which means I never learned anything worth changing it for.

lines.speaker: strand_young
lines.text: I would like a moment. And then I would like to keep going, because a moment is all I have got and I would rather spend the rest of it usefully.
